title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance Benefit Schedule: Callout Allowance, Roll-over and Expiry
content:
## Callout allowance carried by each Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan

The allowance is the number of assistance callouts included in one term. Each plan states whether
unused callouts carry into the next term, the most that may carry, and the number of calendar days an
unused callout stays usable for.

| Plan | Callouts included in one term | Unused callouts carry into the next term | Most that may carry | An unused callout stays usable for (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover | 2 | no | 0 | 365 |
| Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover | 4 | yes | 1 | 365 |
| Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover | 6 | yes | 2 | 540 |
| Keyturn Roadside EV Cover | 6 | yes | 2 | 540 |
| Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover | 12 | yes | 4 | 540 |
| Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover | 10 | yes | 5 | 730 |

### Notes on the schedule

1. Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover is the only plan on which nothing carries into the next term, its
   roll-over ceiling standing at 0 callouts.
2. Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover carries the largest allowance in one term, at 12 callouts, while the
   highest roll-over ceiling is carried by Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover, at 5 callouts against an
   allowance of 10.
3. Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover and Keyturn Roadside EV Cover carry the same figures throughout: 6
   callouts in one term, a roll-over ceiling of 2, and 540 calendar days of usable life.
